dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Rhubarb was surrendered to the care center as a stray, so we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. He has not acclimated well to the kennel environment, and has shown fearful behavior such as reluctance to walk and freezing in place, and has been tense and avoidant of unfamiliar handlers in novel situations. Due to his fearful behavior, we recommend New Hope placement partner who is able to provide an experienced foster home and a period of decompression, to re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Rhubarb
